info.title: PantryPal
info.description: Self-hosted household pantry, recipe, meal-plan and shopping backend. All /api/v1 routes require a bearer API token, unless the server runs with PANTRYPAL_TRUST_NETWORK=1 (then requests without a token act as the household).

bearerAuth.description: API token created with `pantrypal token create --name <name>`.

post.summary: Swap the recipe on one meal slot
post.description: One transaction. scope `with_leftovers` replaces the recipe of the cook that feeds the slot (every slot it feeds changes). scope `this` changes only this meal: a slot sharing its cook with other slots becomes its own cook dated that day. Slots without a cook get a new cook. Cooks already done can't be swapped. Returns the updated plan and whether an open shopping list for it is now stale.

scope.description: `this`: only this meal (a slot that shares a cook with other slots becomes its own cook). `with_leftovers`: the cook that feeds this slot, so every slot it feeds changes.
